symptoms: persistent cough (especially at night or early morning)
shortness of breath on exertion or stairs
wheezing or whistling sound when breathing out
cough triggered by cold air, dust, or allergens
riskFactors: family history of asthma or atopic diseases
exposure to environmental pollutants or secondhand smoke
emergencyRedFlags: severe shortness of breath at rest
inability to speak full sentences in one breath
bluish discoloration of lips or fingernails (cyanosis)
chest retractions
Asthma.whenToSeekHelp: If symptoms worsen, interrupt sleep, or require frequent rescue inhalers, consult a General Practitioner or Pulmonologist promptly.

emergencyRedFlags: systolic BP > 180 mmHg or diastolic BP > 120 mmHg
sudden severe headache with confusion
chest pain radiating to left arm/jaw
sudden weakness or numbness
Hypertension.whenToSeekHelp: If blood pressure readings consistently exceed 140/90 mmHg, or if you experience headaches with dizziness, consult a Cardiologist.

emergencyRedFlags: fruity breath odor with confusion (Diabetic Ketoacidosis)
rapid deep breathing
extreme drowsiness or loss of consciousness
blood glucose > 300 mg/dL
Diabetes.whenToSeekHelp: If you notice persistent thirst, frequent urination, or unexplained weight loss, get your HbA1c or fasting blood glucose tested.

symptoms: evolving size, shape, or surface elevation
non-healing sore or lesion bleeding easily
riskFactors: excessive ultraviolet (UV) radiation or sunburn history
personal or family history of melanoma
emergencyRedFlags: rapidly growing pigmented lesion with central ulceration
spontaneous bleeding from a mole
satellitism or regional lymph node swelling
Skin Condition.whenToSeekHelp: Any new, changing, or non-healing skin spot lasting more than 2-3 weeks should be evaluated by a Dermatologist using dermoscopy.

symptoms: persistent oral ulcer lasting more than 2 weeks
painful or tender sore on tongue, gums, or buccal mucosa
riskFactors: poor oral hygiene or ill-fitting dentures
emergencyRedFlags: rapidly expanding painful floor-of-mouth mass
inability to swallow liquids or saliva
airway compromise from oral swelling
Oral Condition.whenToSeekHelp: An oral ulcer or sore that fails to heal after 14 days requires immediate clinical examination by an Oral Medicine Specialist or Dentist.

symptoms: irregular, missed, or heavy menstrual bleeding
riskFactors: family history of uterine or ovarian fibroids
emergencyRedFlags: sudden severe sharp unilateral pelvic pain with vomiting (Ovarian Torsion / Ectopic Pregnancy)
profuse vaginal hemorrhage
fever with severe pelvic tenderness
Gynaecological Condition.whenToSeekHelp: Consult a Gynaecologist if you experience persistent pelvic pain, irregular cycles lasting over 3 months, or heavy painful periods.

symptoms: eye pain or deep ocular pressure
excessive tearing or dry eye sensation
new eye floaters or light flashes
emergencyRedFlags: sudden painless loss of vision in one eye (Retinal Detachment / Central Retinal Artery Occlusion)
severe eye pain with red eye and nausea (Acute Glaucoma Attack)
Eye Condition.whenToSeekHelp: If you experience sudden vision changes, severe eye pain, or persistent redness, consult an Ophthalmologist immediately.

symptoms: persistent sore or ulcer that doesn't heal
unusual bleeding or discharge from body orifices
changes in skin moles or lesions
unexplained rapid weight loss (>10% body weight)
riskFactors: family history of hereditary cancer syndromes
chronic inflammation or viral infections (HPV, HBV, HCV)
emergencyRedFlags: superior vena cava obstruction symptoms (facial swelling, dyspnea)
spinal cord compression (sudden paralysis/incontinence)
febrile neutropenia
Cancer.whenToSeekHelp: Persistent unexplained symptoms lasting over 2-3 weeks require comprehensive diagnostic evaluation by an Oncologist.

symptoms: shortness of breath during light exertion
joint pain in knees and hips
riskFactors: sedentary lifestyle and lack of physical activity
emergencyRedFlags: severe chest pain on exertion
sudden breathlessness while sleeping (Obstructive Sleep Apnea complication)
Obesity.whenToSeekHelp: If excess weight affects daily mobility, joint health, or causes sleep apnea, consult an Endocrinologist or Bariatric Specialist.

symptoms: swelling and tenderness in multiple joints
morning joint stiffness lasting over 30 minutes
warmth or erythema over joint skin
riskFactors: previous joint trauma or repetitive strain
emergencyRedFlags: single hot, red, extremely painful swollen joint with high fever (Septic Arthritis emergency)
Arthritis.whenToSeekHelp: If joint pain or morning stiffness lasts longer than 2 weeks or limits daily activities, consult a Rheumatologist.
